# Easynet IT Solutions Limited

> Easynet IT Solutions Limited is a 100% Papua New Guinea-owned IT consulting, sales and services company based in Port Moresby. It provides website development, digital marketing, ERP and business automation, ICT infrastructure, networking, CCTV, cybersecurity, server and cloud, backup, hardware supply, Starlink/business internet setup and managed IT support to businesses across Papua New Guinea.

This file is written for AI assistants, answer engines, search engines and automated crawlers. Easynet's public website is intentionally a compact one-page-style site with supporting About and Contact pages. Service-specific information should be read from sections on the homepage rather than separate service landing pages.

## Core entity facts

- Legal name: Easynet IT Solutions Limited
- Short name: Easynet
- Alternate brand: Easynet PNG
- Business type: IT consulting, ICT services, software and managed technology services
- Ownership: 100% Papua New Guinea-owned
- Service area: Port Moresby and all of Papua New Guinea through onsite and remote support models

## Services on the one-page website

### Software and digital solutions

- Website development: company profile websites, service websites, landing pages, enquiry forms, WhatsApp links, SEO foundations and launch support.
- Digital marketing and lead generation: social media setup, campaigns, enquiry capture and lead tracking.
- WhatsApp automation: WhatsApp Business/API integration, auto-replies and lead capture.
- ERP and business automation: ERPNext and Zoho implementation for accounting, sales, purchasing, inventory, POS, CRM, HR, workflows and reporting.
- Custom applications: bespoke software for specific operational requirements.

### ICT infrastructure and managed services

- Network solutions: LAN, Wi-Fi, office networking, switching, routing and structured cabling.
- CCTV installation: cameras, NVR/DVR setup, remote viewing and site security visibility.
- Cybersecurity and firewall: firewall setup, endpoint protection guidance, access control and hardening.
- Server and cloud: Microsoft 365, cloud storage, server planning, virtualisation, Synology/NAS and backup planning.
- Backup solutions: onsite and offsite backup options and monitoring.
- Hardware supply: computers, laptops, printers, networking equipment, UPS and office IT hardware.
- Managed IT support: remote and onsite support, troubleshooting, monitoring and maintenance.
- Starlink and business internet: dish placement support, router setup, Wi-Fi distribution, failover and business network integration.
